Anthlan does not lead from a throne. He builds connections. Among people, ideas and places, he seeks the path that can turn many individuals into a community. His authority comes less from distance than from the certainty that he stays, explains and takes responsibility.

A warrior with a copper-coloured braid wanted to place it on the highest stone. The stone wobbled. Sie lockten den Gegner dorthin, wo ihre: They lured their opponent to a place where their companions could confront it together. Later, when level 110 was defeated, someone looked for the lantern. Their togetherness remained.
